// diagnostic

E3413

Fetch: sha256 mismatch for `{url}`.

What

Fetch: sha256 mismatch for `{url}`.

Why

The downloaded content does not hash to the expected `sha256:` value. The pin ensures every machine gets byte-identical content; a mismatch means the URL content changed or the pin is wrong.

Fix

Update the `sha256:` argument to match the actual content hash shown in the Why line, or verify the URL points to the correct file.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3413: tests/ui/comptime_fetch_pin_mismatch_e3413.stderr.

Error [jet.FetchHashMismatch]: Fetch: sha256 mismatch for `file://comptime_net_fetch_payload.txt`
  --> tests/ui/comptime_fetch_pin_mismatch_e3413.jet:7:25
    |
  7 | PAYLOAD: #run net.fetch("file://comptime_net_fetch_payload.txt", sha256: "e46971c0fe4c87c91ab12d79ce0f8f3de03c27b6c283bc485fe920572d87cdd5")
    |                         ^^^^^
 Why: Expected `e46971c0fe4c87c91ab12d79ce0f8f3de03c27b6c283bc485fe920572d87cdd5` but content hashes to `e46971c0fe4c87c91ab12d79ce0f8f3de03c27b6c283bc485fe920572d87cdd4`
 Fix: Update the `sha256:` pin to match the content, or verify the URL is correct
